name: 蔡一豪
objective:
本課程為「程式設計與人工智慧（一）」之進階課程，著重於 Python 程式設計的延伸應用，並導入機器學習與深度學習之核心概念。課程以 TensorFlow 與 Keras 為主要工具，透過實作多層感知器（MLP）、卷積神經網路（CNN）及循環神經網路（RNN），使學生具備人工智慧模型建構、訓練、評估與應用的能力。
This course is a continuation of Programming and Artificial Intelligence (I). It focuses on advanced Python-based programming techniques and introduces students to machine learning and deep learning concepts. Using TensorFlow and Keras, students will learn to design, train, evaluate, and deploy neural network models, including Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), through hands-on practice and real-world datasets.
schedule:
1.  Course Introduction
2.  Overview of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning
3.  Introduction to TensorFlow and Keras
4.  Setting Up the Deep Learning Development Environment
5.  GPU Acceleration and CUDA Configuration
6.  Midterm Exam I
7.  Fundamentals of Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP)
8.  Data Preprocessing and Feature Engineering
9.  MLP Implementation: Handwritten Digit Recognition
10. Model Evaluation and Overfitting Prevention
11. Fundamentals of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
12. CNN Implementation: Image Classification
13. Fundamentals of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN)
14. Midterm Exam II
15. RNN Implementation: Time-Series Prediction
16. Model Saving and Loading
17. Model Deployment and Practical Applications
18. Final Exam

※ Course schedule and content are subject to adjustment based on students’ learning progress.
scorePolicy:
Midterm Exam I: 30%
Midterm Exam II: 30%
Final Exam: 40%

※ Evaluation items and grading weights are subject to adjustment based on students’ learning progress.
